notes: Only assigned replication fields reviewed. Original and unassigned success fields are placeholders. No explicit target-test analytic N is printed. Page 37 reports 95 participants taking part; rendered Appendix B (p. 42) reports Study 2 Sample Size 92. Neither is explicitly assigned to this particular test, and exclusions/missingness are not explained. No N inferred from df. Both counts retained as sample candidates only. Supplied Table 2 tests web experience, not webpage complexity. Findings give only the joint five-outcome complexity MANOVA (F = .57, p = .84), not the described outcome-specific complexity test. No target-specific F/p is printed in the inspected findings or Appendix B; do not substitute another predictor or joint test. Known mismatch candidate in Table 2: web-experience effect on attitude-toward-the-ad F = 3.532, p = .018.
